about: The model router (owner 2026-10-18). One switch picks the provider for every agent run; each role maps to a tier, and each provider names a model per tier, so a role can be moved between providers or models without touching a script. Switch it with: python tools/autopilot/router.py use qwen|claude [--role R --model M] [--tier T --model M]; read it with: python tools/autopilot/router.py show. No secrets here (the Qwen key lives in ~/.qwen/settings.json, outside the repo).

claude.about: Claude Code CLI (claude.exe). Roles run as .claude/agents/<role>.md subagent definitions with --agent, permissions from tools/autopilot/settings.json in dontAsk mode.

qwen.about: Qwen Code CLI (node on @qwen-code/qwen-code/cli-entry.js). No --agent flag: run-agent.ps1 inlines .claude/agents/<role>.md into the prompt, and the two subagents the orchestrator delegates to are mirrored into .qwen/agents/ (python tools/autopilot/mirror_agents.py). Permissions from .qwen/settings.json (project, committed: the deny list, which is the only gate because runs use --approval-mode yolo) and ~/.qwen/settings.json (user, holds the API key under "env": DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, or BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY for a token-plan key - then use the qwen3.8-max-tp model route). Limits are the CLI's own: --max-session-turns (exit 53) and --max-wall-time (exit 55).

roles.about: One entry per relay role. tier picks the model from the active provider's tier table; turns/minutes bound the run. claude_agent is the .claude/agents definition Claude runs the role with (--agent); null means Claude runs it on the tier model alone. agent_file is that definition's path, which Qwen has no flag for, so run-agent.ps1 inlines it into the prompt instead.

overrides.about: Per-role exceptions to the provider switch: {"<role>": {"provider": "claude", "model": "opus"}}. Empty means every role follows the switch above.
